[attribute-initials]
=== `@initials` Initials for Personal Names

Initial(s) for the surname or the given names of a person.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-given-names,`<given-names>`>>, 
                  <<element-surname,`<surname>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The initial letters of a person’s given names.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
